definition: A first-order composite built only from the three studied vectors: optical softness, shadow density, and halation.
interaction_notes: Halation becomes more visible once highlights survive; dense shadows can hide it.
Optical softness and halation often co-move in Imagine edits.
reconstruction_notes: Preserve subject and framing. Raise optical softness and shadow density as dominant phrases. Add supporting halation. Do not mention cinematic, vintage, or analog.
